title: Mixtures of spatial factor analyzers for tensor-variate data
abstract: arXiv:2607.07887v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A mixture of spatial factor analyzers (MSFA) is introduced to address the challenges of clustering high-dimensional spatial data. The proposed framework utilizes the given coordinate system to implement a flexible, spline-based spatial decay covariance structure. In this approach, the number of covariance parameters increases linearly with the number of spatial locations, rather than increasing quadratically. To model non-spatial dependence, matrix variate factor analyzers are employed for further dimensionality reduction. Parameter estimation is conducted via a variant of the expectation-maximization algorithm combined with a generalized least squares estimator. The proposed models are explored in the context of tensor-variate data analysis, where simulation studies and three applications---Raman spectroscopy, SpecTex hyperspectral textures, and the Salinas hyperspectral scene---illustrate their ability to recover and distingu

translated_title: 面向张量数据的空间因子分析器混合模型
translated_abstract: 本文引入了空间因子分析器混合模型（MSFA），以应对高维空间数据聚类的挑战。所提出的框架利用给定的坐标系来实现一种灵活的、基于样条的空间衰减协方差结构。在这种方法中，协方差参数的数量随空间位置数量呈线性增长，而非二次增长。为了对非空间依赖性进行建模，采用矩阵变量因子分析器进行进一步的降维。参数估计通过期望最大化算法的一种变体并结合广义最小二乘估计器来实现。所提出的模型在张量数据分析的背景下进行了探讨，模拟研究以及三个应用——拉曼光谱、SpecTex高光谱纹理和Salinas高光谱场景——展示了该模型恢复和区分（数据结构）的能力。
tldr: 本文提出空间因子分析器混合模型（MSFA），通过基于样条的空间衰减协方差结构使协方差参数随空间位置线性增长，并结合矩阵变量因子分析器进一步降维，有效实现高维张量空间数据的聚类分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a mixture of spatial factor analyzers (MSFA) for clustering high-dimensional tensor-variate spatial data, employing a spline-based spatial decay covariance structure with linearly increasing parameters and matrix-variate factor analyzers for further dimensionality reduction.
